note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts the revision table and lot number, and accurately binds the South Bedroom Elevation width. Set A repeatedly misbinds overall elevation dimensions to specific components (e.g., assigning wall height to window MWD01), which is a significant engineering error. While both sets confuse some elevation labels and dimensions, Set B provides more verifiable administrative data and avoids the component/wall category errors found in Set A.
remarks: Both sets struggle with correctly mapping dimensions to the specific elevation views (C1, C3, C5, A1, A3, A5), often swapping values between them. Set A's tendency to assign full wall dimensions to components like windows or outlets is particularly problematic for engineering data integrity. Set B's inclusion of the revision history is accurate and useful.
